acceptance.given: The validator inspects package content that may contain prompt-like instructions or malformed structured data.

oracle.expected: The validator treats inspected content as untrusted data, parses it safely, and returns a structured validation result without allowing package content to control validator behavior.
forbidden: Inspected content directs validator control flow or policy through prompt injection.
Malformed or untrusted content is parsed unsafely or triggers arbitrary execution.
oracle.observable: A validator test exercises adversarial prompt-like and malformed package content and observes safe parsing plus a structured diagnostic result.

acceptance.then: Prompt-injection resistance and safe parsing are enforced for inspected package content.
acceptance.when: Execute the validator against adversarial and malformed package inputs and inspect its structured result and boundary behavior.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The planned validator safety test fails with an assertion when inspected content can influence validator behavior or is parsed unsafely.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce untrusted-content handling and safe parsing in the package validator while preserving structured diagnostics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only validator safety-handling changes; preserve the versioned result shape and read-only behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Validator inspection changes from unconstrained parsing to explicit safe parsing of untrusted package content.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused validator safety test passes and demonstrates that adversarial or malformed package content cannot control validator behavior or trigger unsafe parsing.
